//! What `greeting list` promises its caller, one row of `CASES` for each case it has.

use crate::cases::{Case, Expect, Word, run};

type Input = Vec<&'static str>;
type Value = String;
type Failure = crate::outcome::Outcome;

/// The rows of this command's cases.
const CASES: &[Case<Input, Value, Failure>] = &[
    Case {
        name: "list prints a greeting",
        word: Word::Succeeds,
        input: || vec!["list"],
        expect: Expect::Value(String::from("hello")),
    },
    Case {
        name: "list ends in error when the service fails",
        word: Word::Fails,
        input: || vec!["list"],
        expect: Expect::Error(crate::outcome::Outcome::Error),
    },
];

/// Runs `greeting list` on one command line.
fn subject(line: Input) -> Result<Value, Failure> {
    todo!("parse the command line, run the command, return what it printed or the outcome it ended with")
}

#[test]
fn succeeds() {
    run(CASES, Word::Succeeds, subject);
}

#[test]
fn fails() {
    run(CASES, Word::Fails, subject);
}
